annotations.text: WK-2092 acceptance criterion 1: Purpose and closure.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 2: Ownership and non-duplication.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 3: Closed proposal.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 4: No semantic invention.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 5: Proposal completeness.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 6: Deduplication and conflicts.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 7: Continuation binding.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 8: Bounds.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 9: Multi-source CAS.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 10: Atomic prospective persistence.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 11: Task-directed result.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 12: Failure vocabulary.
WK-2092 acceptance criterion 13: Implementation handoff.

DRY-001 accepted: writeControlledContractCarrierSet is the single publication, locking, staging, cleanup, recovery, and receipt owner; WK-2092 generalizes its admitted carrier population and introduces no second transaction.

DRY-002 accepted: applyControlledContractCarrierPatch owns every per-carrier mutation and applyStableVerificationBundles owns test_execution graphs; WK-2092 adds only cross-carrier completeness and prospective-set composition.

DRY-003 accepted: CONTROLLED_CONTRACT_AUTHORING_REASONS and its existing projector own stale, conflict, and replacement-call outcomes; WK-2092 adds only proposal-specific reasons that have no existing equivalent.

RT-001 KEEP after blueteam: canonical authoring reads must resolve the generation manifest published by writeControlledContractCarrierSet; no second transaction or general artifact-store redesign is allowed.
RT-002 KEEP after blueteam: writeControlledContractCarrierSet gains owner-local dead-owner lock quarantine and orphan staging reconciliation; live or unverifiable owners remain untouched.

RT-003 KEEP after blueteam: the pure applyControlledContractCarrierPatch primitive moves to controlled-contract and wiki-core imports/re-exports it, preserving one implementation and the accepted DRY-002 disposition.

RT-004 KEEP after blueteam: the existing canonical source lease is generalized over a server-derived prospective basename population so present and expected-absent carriers are locked and snapshotted together.
RT-005 KEEP after blueteam: operation and byte maxima use inclusive range:has_cardinality semantics rather than exact cardinality.
RT-006 NARROW after blueteam: bytes mean Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify of the fixed-key server-created proposal projection), utf8; canonical JSON and raw-wire preservation are excluded.

RT-007 NARROW after blueteam: cross-carrier comparison binds stableSemanticKey plus validateSuppliedProofPackBindings compatibility semantics and adds only carrier provenance; no new identity model is introduced.

OBL-001: Bind one exact selected-pack authoring skeleton input. Mechanism=workspace_controlled_proof_authoring_skeleton; inputs=exact pack/version, intents, bindings; outputs=server-held continuation plus missing-role state; authority=package catalog and continuation identity; failure/effect boundary=cross-pack or unresolved input refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=complete-selection and wrong-pack fixtures.

OBL-002: Freeze a closed proposal identity over WK, focus, contract digest, pack, intents, and continuation. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs proposal constructor; inputs=closed identity tuple; outputs=controlled-proof-graph-proposal.v1; authority=package schema; failure/effect boundary=unknown or mismatched identity refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=exact identity and cross-WK fixtures.

OBL-003: Represent carrier operations only with the existing carrier-patch target/op/id/value grammar. Mechanism=applyControlledContractCarrierPatch; inputs=ordered carrier operations; outputs=prospective carrier bytes or typed refusal; authority=controlled-contract package; failure/effect boundary=unsupported carrier or operation refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=supported and unsupported operation fixtures.

OBL-004: Route test_execution graphs only through the stable verification-bundle owner. Mechanism=applyStableVerificationBundles; inputs=test_execution entries; outputs=validated prospective graph or typed refusal; authority=controlled-contract package; failure/effect boundary=bundle conflict refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=inspection versus test_execution fixtures.

OBL-005: Refuse unknown proposal keys, unsupported carriers/operations, identity conflicts, and more than 64 operations. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs closed schema; inputs=proposal object; outputs=typed refusal before effects; authority=controlled-contract package; failure/effect boundary=closed-schema or range violation; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=unknown-key and 65-operation fixtures.

OBL-006: Require caller-authored reference identities and type terms. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs semantic completeness; inputs=reference selections; outputs=bound references; authority=coordinator input only; failure/effect boundary=missing or ambiguous JSON pointer; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=missing-reference fixture.

OBL-007: Require caller-authored population identities, membership, and applicability. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs semantic completeness; inputs=population selections; outputs=bound populations; authority=coordinator input only; failure/effect boundary=missing or ambiguous JSON pointer; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=missing-membership/applicability fixtures.

OBL-008: Require caller-authored proposition subjects, operators, contexts, and operands. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs semantic completeness; inputs=proposition selections; outputs=bound propositions; authority=coordinator input only; failure/effect boundary=missing or ambiguous JSON pointer; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=missing-operand fixture.

OBL-009: Require caller-authored claim, verification, falsifier, relation, collection, residue, annotation, binding, intent, and pack choices. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs semantic completeness; inputs=remaining graph selections; outputs=complete proposal; authority=coordinator input only; failure/effect boundary=exact unresolved JSON pointer; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=missing-verification/relation/binding/intent fixtures.

OBL-010: Derive only immutable schema/version fields, basenames, carrier ordering, and digests. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs derivation allowlist; inputs=complete semantic selection; outputs=closed derived envelope; authority=package-owned deterministic projection; failure/effect boundary=semantic invention is forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;caller-input-authority-confinement; fixture=mutation removing semantic input.

OBL-011: Return exact unresolved semantic JSON pointers and persist nothing when choices are missing. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs unresolved projection; inputs=incomplete selection; outputs=bounded pointer list and refusal; authority=package planner is pure; failure/effect boundary=no candidate or carrier mutation; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=each missing semantic class.

OBL-012: Require the exact selected pack skeleton to have no unresolved required roles. Mechanism=workspace_controlled_proof_authoring_skeleton plus planner completeness; inputs=skeleton role state; outputs=executable or unresolved proposal; authority=package pack profile; failure/effect boundary=missing role blocks publication; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=complete and one-role-missing fixtures.

OBL-013: Admit every operation through its existing per-carrier owner. Mechanism=applyControlledContractCarrierPatch/applyStableVerificationBundles; inputs=composed operations; outputs=owner-admitted prospective carrier; authority=existing package owners; failure/effect boundary=owner refusal preserved; proof=implementation-readiness;behavioral-preservation; fixture=owner mutation fixtures.

OBL-014: Require every referenced identity to exist in the final prospective carrier set. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs final-target check; inputs=prospective carriers; outputs=complete reference closure; authority=package planner; failure/effect boundary=missing target refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=missing-final-target fixture.

OBL-015: Require exact population members to be distinct and present. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs population completeness; inputs=prospective populations; outputs=closed population set; authority=package planner plus existing normalizer; failure/effect boundary=duplicate/missing member refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=duplicate and absent-member fixtures.

OBL-016: Require every selected intent to be admitted by the exact selected pack. Mechanism=proof-pack selection/admission owner; inputs=pack/version and intents; outputs=admitted selection; authority=controlled-contract package catalog; failure/effect boundary=unsupported intent refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=admitted and foreign-intent fixtures.

OBL-017: Co-validate prospective contract, evaluation input, and proof-plan request before publication. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs composition validator; inputs=three prospective carriers; outputs=validated carrier set; authority=controlled-contract package; failure/effect boundary=any invalid carrier refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=one-invalid-carrier fixtures.

OBL-018: Preserve same-carrier duplicate, conflict, ordering, dangling-reference, canonicalization, and bundle semantics. Mechanism=applyControlledContractCarrierPatch/applyStableVerificationBundles; inputs=same-carrier operations; outputs=unchanged stable-v1 results; authority=existing owners; failure/effect boundary=existing exact errors preserved; proof=implementation-readiness;behavioral-preservation; fixture=legacy regression corpus.

OBL-019: Use stableSemanticKey and validateSuppliedProofPackBindings only for cross-carrier equality and compatibility. Mechanism=stableSemanticKey/validateSuppliedProofPackBindings; inputs=cross-carrier identities; outputs=collapsed compatible binding or typed conflict; authority=existing package owners; failure/effect boundary=type/kind/value mismatch refuses; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=NFC equal and mismatch fixtures.

OBL-020: Treat exact replay as no-op only when every owner no-ops and manifest bytes still match. Mechanism=planner no-op aggregation plus canonical manifest; inputs=exact repeated proposal; outputs=no-op receipt; authority=package and core owners jointly; failure/effect boundary=any byte/digest drift refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;idempotent-effect-nonduplication; fixture=exact replay and drift fixtures.

OBL-021: Bind continuation to exact identities, bindings, package version, role state, and proposal digest. Mechanism=controlled-contract-authoring-state continuation; inputs=server-held authoring state; outputs=content-addressed continuation; authority=wiki-core state owner; failure/effect boundary=stale/tampered/cross-identity refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;fenced-handoff; fixture=single-field tamper fixtures.

OBL-022: Permit continuation reuse only at proof_graph_required for its exact purpose. Mechanism=controlled-contract-authoring-state; inputs=continuation and stage; outputs=one allowed next call; authority=wiki-core state owner; failure/effect boundary=wrong-stage/reuse refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;caller-input-authority-confinement; fixture=stage-reuse fixtures.

OBL-023: Reuse CONTROLLED_CONTRACT_AUTHORING_REASONS/projector and add only three named proposal reasons. Mechanism=controlled-contract-authoring-state reason vocabulary; inputs=typed failures; outputs=existing compact refusal envelope; authority=wiki-core vocabulary owner; failure/effect boundary=unnamed fallback forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;result-shape-conformance; fixture=each existing and new reason fixture.

OBL-024: Enforce inclusive carrier_operations length 0 through 64. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs range check; inputs=closed operation array; outputs=accepted count or bound refusal; authority=package planner; failure/effect boundary=65 refuses before candidate construction; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=0,1,64,65 fixtures.

OBL-025: Enforce inclusive UTF-8 JSON byte count 0 through 1048576 over the fixed-key server projection. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs byte projection; inputs=server-created fixed-key projection; outputs=accepted count or bound refusal; authority=package planner; failure/effect boundary=1048577 refuses before candidate construction; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=below,exact,N+1 byte fixtures.

OBL-026: On either bound overflow, return controlled_contract_proof_graph_bound_exceeded before effects with no paging/narrowing. Mechanism=proof-graph-composition-v1.mjs refusal branch; inputs=oversize proposal; outputs=typed bounded refusal; authority=package planner; failure/effect boundary=no partial candidate or mutation; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=operation and byte overflow fixtures.

OBL-027: Derive the complete prospective canonical basename set server-side and reject caller paths/basenames. Mechanism=withCanonicalControlledContractSourceLease generalization; inputs=WK/focus/pack/intents/catalog/proposal; outputs=sorted canonical basenames; authority=wiki-core resolver authority; failure/effect boundary=caller path/root/env is forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;caller-input-authority-confinement; fixture=injected path/root/env fixtures.

OBL-028: Under one ordered lease, snapshot every prospective basename as present-with-digest or absent and re-resolve all bound sources. Mechanism=withCanonicalControlledContractSourceLease; inputs=server-derived basename set; outputs=leased source snapshot; authority=wiki-core lease owner; failure/effect boundary=source mismatch refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;fenced-handoff; fixture=present/absent and each stale-source fixture.

OBL-029: Refuse any leased-source mismatch before candidate construction through the existing projector. Mechanism=canonical source lease plus refusal projector; inputs=post-proposal source state; outputs=exact stale/conflict refusal; authority=wiki-core owners; failure/effect boundary=no mutation; proof=implementation-readiness;refusal-before-effects; fixture=each source changes independently.

OBL-030: Publish a complete verified private generation by atomically switching one canonical generation manifest. Mechanism=writeControlledContractCarrierSet canonical_authoring profile; inputs=validated carrier population; outputs=manifest-selected generation receipt; authority=wiki-core publisher; failure/effect boundary=write/verify/manifest failure never exposes partial; proof=implementation-readiness;atomicity.failure-boundary; fixture=failure injection at every boundary.

OBL-031: Resolve all canonical authoring reads through one manifest and never mix root and generation members. Mechanism=canonical generation resolver; inputs=manifest-selected generation; outputs=single-generation carrier set; authority=wiki-core resolver; failure/effect boundary=missing/inconsistent member refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;visibility-after-durable-settlement; fixture=mixed-root/generation mutation fixture.

OBL-032: Use legacy root carriers only as the locked seed for the first generation. Mechanism=canonical generation resolver; inputs=no-manifest root snapshot; outputs=generation-one seed; authority=wiki-core resolver/lease; failure/effect boundary=post-manifest root use forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;behavioral-preservation; fixture=first-generation and post-manifest fixtures.

OBL-033: Route later single-carrier create/patch and proof-plan build through complete next-generation publication. Mechanism=writeControlledContractCarrierSet canonical_authoring profile; inputs=single-carrier logical edit; outputs=complete next generation; authority=wiki-core publisher; failure/effect boundary=direct root write forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;atomicity.failure-boundary; fixture=each legacy entrypoint fixture.

OBL-034: Return success/no-op only after manifest re-resolution and authoring-state re-read match the plan. Mechanism=canonical publisher plus authoring-state resolver; inputs=planned generation; outputs=verified receipt and next-state call; authority=wiki-core publisher/state owners; failure/effect boundary=post-publish mismatch refuses; proof=implementation-readiness;visibility-after-durable-settlement; fixture=success, no-op, and mismatch fixtures.

OBL-035: Expose proof_graph_required with exact pack, missing identities, unresolved pointers, and one next call; never claim proof or dispatch readiness. Mechanism=workspace_controlled_contract_authoring_state; inputs=current carriers and selection; outputs=compact task-directed state; authority=wiki-core state owner; failure/effect boundary=complete carriers/candidate populations excluded; proof=implementation-readiness;result-shape-conformance; fixture=required-stage compactness fixtures.

OBL-036: Recover only a proven-dead exact lock owner via atomic quarantine, fresh exclusive acquisition, and dead-owner artifact reconciliation. Mechanism=writeControlledContractCarrierSet owner-local recovery; inputs=lock token plus process/start identity; outputs=new exclusive owner or busy; authority=wiki-core lock owner; failure/effect boundary=unproven death cannot reclaim; proof=implementation-readiness;single-winner-effect; fixture=process-death/restart fixtures.

OBL-037: Leave live or unverifiable lock owners and their artifacts untouched. Mechanism=writeControlledContractCarrierSet contention path; inputs=current lock identity; outputs=busy refusal; authority=wiki-core lock owner; failure/effect boundary=no expiry guess or cleanup; proof=implementation-readiness;forbidden-operation-noninvocation; fixture=live and unverifiable owner fixtures.

OBL-038: Clean ordinary failures in-invocation and expose only complete prior or planned generations; never canonicalize partial state. Mechanism=writeControlledContractCarrierSet failure paths; inputs=failure at each write/verify/manifest boundary; outputs=cleanup or recoverable dead-owner state; authority=wiki-core publisher; failure/effect boundary=partial manifest/generation forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;atomicity.failure-boundary; fixture=ordinary failure and kill/restart fixtures.

OBL-039: Assign package extraction, proposal planning, bounds, joins, and package tests only to WK-2098. Mechanism=WK-2098 contract/write scope; inputs=WK-2092 package obligations; outputs=independent package delivery; authority=WK-2098 worker; failure/effect boundary=wiki-core/MCP edits out of scope; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=scope-confinement review fixture.

OBL-040: Assign core import/re-export, generation/lease/recovery/state integration, and core tests only to dependent WK-2099. Mechanism=WK-2099 contract/write scope; inputs=WK-2092 core obligations after WK-2098; outputs=independent core delivery; authority=WK-2099 worker; failure/effect boundary=package/MCP edits out of scope; proof=implementation-readiness; fixture=dependency and scope fixture.

OBL-041: Assign MCP route/discovery/docs/tests only to dependent WK-2100 and dispatch no implementation from WK-2092. Mechanism=WK-2100 contract/write scope plus WK-2092 closure; inputs=WK-2092 MCP obligations after WK-2099; outputs=independent MCP delivery records; authority=WK-2100 worker; coordinator owns dispatch; failure/effect boundary=implementation dispatch from WK-2092 forbidden; proof=implementation-readiness;write-confinement; fixture=dependency, scope, and no-dispatch fixture.

Obligation-coverage gate: 41/41 atomic obligations mapped to exact implementation mechanisms, preserved inputs/outputs, authority and failure/effect boundaries, applicable proof packs, and named discriminating fixtures; 0 unresolved gaps and 0 placeholders.
